explanation: This unit tracks how late it is in the episode: it stays at 0 through about trial 65, reaches 1-2 around trials 65-80, and rises sharply from about trial 85 to the end. In those late trials GO is highest (7-10, usually 10 after trial 92, and a bit higher for a2), D2 comes next (5-9, plus 2-3 when the transition was rare), and D1 is lowest (2-8, about 2-3 lower when the previous trial was unrewarded), with every step climbing toward trial 99.
